stem.text: Stationary sound waves can be formed in the air columns of pipes. One type of pipe is closed at one end and open at the other end. Another type of pipe is open at both ends.
Which pipe can form a stationary sound wave with the lowest frequency?

A.alt: Pipe drawn as two vertical lines, open at both ends, with a double-headed dimension arrow on its left labelled 2L.

B.alt: Pipe drawn as two vertical lines, closed at the bottom end, with a double-headed dimension arrow on its left labelled 2L.

C.alt: Pipe drawn as two vertical lines, open at both ends, with a double-headed dimension arrow on its left labelled L.

D.alt: Pipe drawn as two vertical lines, closed at the bottom end, with a double-headed dimension arrow on its left labelled L.
